description: Start building a synthetic organisation from a prompt. Returns 202 with an orgId. The build runs in the background (minutes) — then poll get_org, or call wait_for_org to block until ready. Omit projectId to auto-create a project (named after the generated company) — the simplest path.

projectId.description: Existing project to build into; OMIT to auto-create one

ref_org_id.description: Build a variant FROM an existing org

web_search.description: Use web search for real-world grounding (default true; set false to disable)

name: build_org
title: Build organisation (async)
